name: Full Cycle raises Hand of Elune's Full Moon healing and cuts its New Moon cost by 10% (#2269)
contract: Full Cycle 704343 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32) carries three SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) effects that never address Hand of Elune 801990 directly: effect 0 op SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 (23) +10 on mask word1 0x200, which is the family flag of Full Moon Hidden 800391, whose effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) SPELLMOD_DAMAGE with base -1 (value 0) on mask word1 0x40000 (Hand of Elune); effect 2 op SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 (12) -10 on mask word0 0x400000, the family flag of New Moon 800394, whose effect 1 is aura 108 with base -1 (value 0). The tooltip reads 'Full Moon: Healing increased by $s1%. New Moon: Cost reduced by $s3%.' Before the fix nothing applied 800391 (no trigger, learn or module reference; Full Moon 800393 has only its crit aura and the phase trigger), and 800394's effect 1 aimed its percent mod at the client cost helper 704518 (family flag word2 0x8000) that this core never applies, since Hand of Elune's cost is the StarcallerCosts contract (20% of maximum mana, UsesMaxManaForCost). Fix: the lifecycle aura script casts 800391 on Full Moon apply and removes it on remove, and the load-time contract retargets 800394 effect 1 to SPELLMOD_COST on Hand of Elune's mask; both amounts are then computed by the native Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers (SpellInfo.cpp CalcValue) and the native SPELLMOD_COST path in SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost, which the module cost contract keeps. Both fixtures share race, class and level, so max mana, spell power and coefficients are identical and only the talent moves the ratio: healing ratio 1.10 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE pct on the final heal, Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone), cost ratio 0.90 (20% of max mana times 0.9, truncated to int, hence the 0.89-0.91 window). Fixtures learn 500206 back to back, so both start Full Moon within milliseconds; each phase lasts 10000 ms (SpellDuration 1). The snapshot and the assert follow each other within milliseconds, well inside a phase.
